name: Composite Blast Technique
body:
Prerequisite(s): Kineticist 7.

Benefit(s): If your primary element grants a composite blast for having an expanded element with it (such as metal blast for earth), you gain access to that composite blast.

Special: A fusion kineticist can take this feat a second time at 11th level, applying its effects to their sub element.
